# 📊 Mermaid Diagram Generator / Mermaid图表生成器

> Generate architecture, flow, and sequence diagrams from code comments or specs. / 从代码注释或规格说明生成架构图、流程图和时序图。

> 🦁 **由 KingAI.Work 出品** — 智能进化｜vip@kingai.work

---

## Features / 功能特性

• Understands natural language descriptions to turn your specs into clean Mermaid diagrams. / 用自然语言描述你的架构思路，AI就能自动生成标准Mermaid图表，告别手绘与调试。
• Supports flowcharts, sequence diagrams, class diagrams, and Gantt charts. / 覆盖流程图、时序图、类图、甘特图等多种经典类型，一步到位满足技术文档需求。
• Automatically suggests layout improvements and node styling for readability. / 自动优化布局比例与节点配色，生成的图表天生清晰易读，无需二次排版。
• Integrates with code comments to generate live diagrams from your source annotations. / 直接从代码注释提取关系，让图表始终与代码逻辑同步，减少维护成本。
• Pro: Export diagrams to high-resolution SVG/PNG with branding and custom themes. / 专业版支持导出高清SVG/PNG，可嵌入企业品牌色与自定义主题。
• Pro: One-click conversion from complex JSON/YAML specs without manual editing. / 专业版一键解析JSON/YAML规格文件，直接生成复杂架构图，告别手动录入。

## Quick Start / 快速开始

```bash
mermaid-diagram-generator "User login flow: user fills form, sends request, server validates, returns token" // Generates a clean sequence diagram for the entire user login process. / 基于自然语言描述，直接生成完整的用户登录流程时序图。 
```

## Use Cases / 使用场景

• A backend developer documents a new microservice architecture in their README, turning written notes into a clear deployment diagram. / 后端开发人员在README中描述微服务调用关系，AI自动转为部署架构图，团队协作一眼看懂。
• A product manager creates a user journey flowchart from meeting notes, saving hours of manual drawing in design tools. / 产品经理根据会议纪要描述用户操作路径，秒出用户旅程流程图，不再依赖手动绘制。
• A team lead transforms code review comments into a sequence diagram to visualize an async processing flow. / 技术主管将代码评审中的异步逻辑描述转化为时序图，精准定位数据流瓶颈。
